aiMetadata.description: Creates a new email campaign in Sendy from the supplied from/reply-to addresses, subject, and HTML (plus optional plain text), targeting selected lists/segments. By default it is saved as a draft, but it can instead be sent immediately or scheduled for a future date/time via the auto-send and schedule options. Use to author or dispatch a campaign; HTML body and sender fields are required. Not idempotent — each call creates (and may send) a separate campaign.
